MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WHERE CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) >= 24
  AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) >= 0
  AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) < 1
  AND (
    CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) < 1984
    OR (
      CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1984
      AND (
        CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) < 10
        OR (
          CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10
          AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) <= 14
        )
      )
    )
  )
RETURN CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) AS col1, CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) AS col2, CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) AS col3, p.name AS name_player
